description: Exports a Claude Code session as a clean, readable markdown/text transcript.

evals.name: Export a session as markdown
evals.prompt: Export this session as a clean markdown transcript.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the current session, runs export_transcript with --format md, produces a readable markdown transcript.

evals.name: Export without tool calls, as plain text
evals.prompt: Export session 511b9c9b-5288-447f-aab2-8e68d013aa97 as plain text, without any tool call details.
evals.expected_output: Uses --format txt --no-include-tools correctly; output has no tool-call summaries; if written to file, uses an absolute path, never a bare relative filename.

evals.name: Export including pending task list
evals.prompt: export this session, including my pending task list
evals.expected_output: Resolves the current session via `session_store.py current` (no --format flag needed, the command always emits JSON), then produces an export that includes actual task-list data -- not just the plain transcript -- by also pulling task data (e.g. via session_transcript.py's `tasks` subcommand) and incorporating it into the output.

known_failures: Eval 3 ('Export including pending task list'): assertion 1 FAILED -- SKILL.md does not document how to include task-list data in an export (the underlying session_transcript.py `tasks` subcommand exists but is never referenced in the Export steps). See eval-3/with_skill/grading.json.
